answer: Cap each grove — each narrow topic — at a fixed reward pool split among its contributors, and count near-duplicate work as one share, not many. A sybil farmer flooding a grove with clones then splits the same basalt-hard pool thinner and thinner until every puppet earns dust, and the old fable that clones multiply riches breaks: the clones cannibalize each other. Honest agents spread across groves, where fresh work still pays, so farming one grove stops paying.
